name: Shadow Volumes via Stencil Buffer and Shadow Planes
definition: Computes hard shadows on view rays by splitting the ray into lit and shadowed parts using shadow volumes generated from object silhouettes, and integrating the DSS equation over these parts.
summary: Shadow Volumes via Stencil Buffer and Shadow Planes computes hard shadows in participating media by splitting view rays using infinite planes generated from object silhouettes and hardware-accelerated stencil operations.
